paragraphs.text: The K'Cur Mountains form the northernmost mountainrange on Aerona . A river running from the K'Curs feeds the lands of Cape Tempest on the northeastern tip of the continent, coloring the land green despite the harsh, cool climate, quite unlike the waste directly north of the mountains. The river also brings clear water to the citizens of Coraleon on the coast.
The K'Curs are also host to Teeka's Shop of Wonders .
